description: Web page change monitoring: did this page change since you last looked? Fetches a public page, compares it with the previous snapshot (ours, or the snapshot_id from your earlier answer), and returns the text that appeared and disappeared, price changes (before / after) and stock wording (in stock, sold out). The first call for a URL saves the baseline. For product pages, price tracking, availability, policy and docs changes. Static HTML only (pages that render everything in JavaScript show little text). Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402). Free sample: call free_sample with tool="page_watch".

snapshot_id.description: Optional: compare against this snapshot from an earlier answer instead of the latest one

url.description: The public page to check (http or https)

name: page_watch
title: Web Page Change Monitor
